required_before_public_header.decision_required: Keep lifecycle/config/logging separate from watchdog, hot reload, restart, and recovery APIs.
Do not add lifecycle ops recovery public header symbols, capability bits, callback ABI, or ops API until every blocker is resolved.
Define callback quiescence, unload drain, worker shutdown, and dlclose safety before any hot reload or restart orchestration API exists.
Define operator reload ingress, authorization, audit, rollback, and failure reporting before any reload command API exists.
Define multi-instance restart-state and recovery semantics with explicit fail-closed behavior before any recovery API exists.
Define crash containment and watchdog behavior that does not run plugin code after unsafe failure before any watchdog API exists.
Add SDK consumer or integration coverage for the promoted ops recovery contract before adding public header symbols.
A v1 release statement must name obelisk.lifecycle_ops_recovery.v1 as post-v1 or explicitly excluded until this surface is promoted.

non_claims: This manifest does not add public header symbols.
This manifest does not promote obelisk.lifecycle_ops_recovery.v1.
This manifest does not make lifecycle/config/logging sufficient for watchdog, reload, restart, or recovery behavior.
This manifest does not authorize runtime tests, server access, marker edits, restarts, Discord notices, commits, tags, or pushes.
